messages:
maria-sales: Heads up — GreenArc just uploaded an RFI addendum asking for an explicit SLA penalty clause and a sample POC schedule. I saved the PDF to the thread: https://files.redwood/gf/addendum-greenarc.pdf. Can we align on bullets to respond by EOD?

anya-se: Saw it, thanks. Quick context: they want 99.9% across both Dedicated and Private for inference latency/availability. We normally do 99.95 for Dedicated and best-effort for Private unless they buy enterprise support. Suggest we propose a tiered SLA and call out Private as "enterprise-managed" with different guarantees.

jeff-solutions: +1. Also note they asked for a replayable eval corpus + sample metrics. We can provide a sanitized eval set for the POC but need legal signoff for sharing customer-like prompts. @eve-legal can you confirm what we can release?

 tom-sre: From ops perspective: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) — 99.95% uptime SLA on supported regions is fine. Private (VPC/on-prem) — we should state that uptime depends on customer infra; we can offer an SLA when we manage the control plane and networking (partnered installs) and include a runbook for recovery.

maria-sales: Perfect. On pricing they want a line-item POC cost (per-GPU/day, storage, egress). I have a draft breakdown: GPU (p4d equivalent) $X/day, engineer support $Y/day, data egress $Z. I can attach an itemized sheet. I also added an optional add-on for accelerated tuning.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: capability_matrix_greenarc_v1.xlsx (uploaded by maria-sales) :paperclip:

anya-se: Thanks for the matrix. A few asks to add: HSM/KMS options (customer asked about BYOK), quantization/latency tradeoff notes, and the Optimize presets (auto-batching + KV-cache) under "cost controls."

jeff-solutions: Also add a short note about fallback policies — if Dedicated capacity is constrained we can route to a compatible quantized model or lower-cost region. That matters for their "always-on" use case.

maria-sales: Good call. For the SLA penalty language they asked for liquidated damages (% of monthly invoice). We should avoid a flat percentage clause without legal signoff. Proposing: state crediting mechanism tied to measured downtime windows with max cap (e.g., credits up to X% of monthly fees). @eve-legal?

eve-legal: Agreed we should avoid open-ended liability. Draft clause suggestion: "In the event Redwood fails to meet the Service Level for Dedicated services, Customer may be eligible for a Service Credit up to a capped percentage of monthly fees as defined in the SLA schedule. For Private deployments, credits apply only when Redwood manages the control plane; otherwise remedies are limited to support escalation." I can paste a redline by EOD.

anya-se: For the POC schedule the customer expects a 7-day window. Proposed quick draft (feel free to copy):

```
POC schedule (draft)
Day 0: Kickoff, account & access, scope alignment
Day 1: Provision Dedicated nodes / Private install checklist
Day 2: Baseline inference benchmarks (latency, throughput)
Day 3: Integrations (ingest, auth, KMS)
Day 4: Run eval corpus + quality checks
Day 5: Tuning: batching, KV cache, quantize trials
Day 6: Final run & transfer of artifacts, review
Day 7: Acceptance, handoff & next steps
```

jeff-solutions: That schedule looks good. Add a short bullet for observability setup (token-level cost dashboard + per-route tracing) on Day 1 or Day 2.

maria-sales: Will add. One more customer ask: FedRAMP / compliance readiness timeline. We don't have FedRAMP but we can outline controls, SOC2 status, and a roadmap estimate if they require FedRAMP. @eve-legal can you add a line for compliance artifacts we can share?

eve-legal: I can attach the SOC2 summary and the current compliance roadmap. We can offer a redacted audit artifact set for pre-sales. I will upload by noon.

tom-sre: Ops note — for the POC we should provide a default autoscaling profile and a recommended batch size matrix for their target RPS to show cost vs latency. I'll add a small table to the matrix.

maria-sales: Awesome. Next steps: I will update the RFI response PDF with the SLA tier language, attach capability_matrix_greenarc_v2.xlsx (with the SE and ops updates), and include the POC schedule. I'll ping the contact once we have legal redlines. Target: send to customer tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

anya-se: happy to review the capability matrix + the POC runbook this afternoon.

jeff-solutions: I'll prepare the sanitized eval set and sample Jupyter notebook for reproducible runs.

maria-sales: Great — thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Message pinned to channel by maria-sales: 1766123456 (RFI thread).
